answers.question: What are the dimensions of the NC-PCB concrete barrier?
answers.answer: The NC-PCB is 10 ft. long, 24 in. wide at the base, and 32 in. high [1].

answers.question: When must portable concrete barrier on a bridge deck be anchored?
answers.answer: Portable concrete barrier on a bridge deck must be anchored when the clearance from the back of the barrier to the edge of the deck is 6 feet or less [1].

answers.question: Who pays for a detour when a utility closes a road?
answers.answer: The encroaching party shall reimburse NCDOT for any costs incurred in developing, improving, signing, marking, and maintaining a detour route. [1]

answers.question: What is the minimum cover for a utility installed by bore and jack?
answers.answer: The minimum cover for a utility installed by bore and jack is 3 feet. [1]

answers.question: How many TODS panels can go on one intersection approach?
answers.answer: A maximum of six TODS panels may be installed on a single intersection approach, with only one attraction per panel. If only one TODS assembly can fit on the approach, the limit is three panels. [1][2]

answers.question: How long does a regional office have to complete a fatal crash investigation?
answers.answer: The expectation for completion of a fatal crash investigation is 60 calendar days (45 business days) from Step 4 in the Workflow Tracker, though this may be waived at the discretion of the Regional Traffic Engineer (RTE) or other superior due to special circumstances [1].

answers.question: What fees does an attraction pay for a TODS sign?
answers.answer: An attraction pays a $200 non‑refundable fee that covers the application and first annual maintenance fee per contract (intersection) [1][2][3]. Construction costs are due within 30 days of final contract approval and are in addition to the initial payment [2][3]. An annual maintenance fee of $200 per contract is due each July 1 [1][2][3]. A prorated maintenance fee is charged for the period between panel placement and the next July 1 [2]. A service charge of $200 per TODS panel applies when an attraction requests sign replacement or masking/unmasking for seasonal attractions [1][2].
